reuse.why: Uses the existing monthUtils parse/format helpers and keeps both holiday consumers in shared/schedules.ts, but does not introduce a single holiday-matching predicate for both to use.

duplication.why: The MM-DD interpretation is written twice: as isYearlyHoliday + per-year expansion with dayMatchesMonthDay in recurConfigToExdates, and as a `str.slice(5)` set lookup inside getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

placement.why: Both changes sit in shared/schedules.ts where holidays are already interpreted, and the type comment documents the format.

scope.why: Only holiday interpretation, its tests, a type comment and a release note.

maintainability.why: Two different encodings of the yearly rule must be kept in sync, and expanding yearly holidays into ~100+ years of exdates with a hard-coded horizon is a fragile design.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared holiday predicate existed before; both existing holiday consumers are extended in place.

disguised_duplication.where: The 'MM-DD matches this day in any year' rule appears as dayMatchesMonthDay(date, day) / isYearlyHoliday in recurConfigToExdates and as holidaySet.has(str.slice(5)) in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, reshaped rather than shared.
